summary: This is a standard Form 8-K filed by RMG ML Sports Holdings, a blank-check company (SPAC), reporting the closing of its initial public offering (IPO) and related private placement. The company sold 20,000,000 units at $10.00 each, raising $200M in gross proceeds, plus a partial exercise of the over-allotment option for 1,650,000 additional units on June 15, 2026. Simultaneously, the sponsor purchased 210,000 private placement units at $10.00 each. Proceeds totaling $200M are held in trust. This filing does not constitute a special situation; it merely documents the IPO closing and trust deposit.
